About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Mobile developer to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

jobs.title: Senior iOS Engineer (Swift/SwiftUI) - Portugal Full Remote
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITYJoin a fast-growing EdTech startup helping more than 1.
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

Join a fast-growing EdTech startup helping more than 1.5 million students worldwide learn better and stay motivated through an AI-powered education platform. With tens of thousands of new students joining every week and recent seed funding, the team is expanding its mobile experience.

As a Senior iOS Engineer, you will take hands-on ownership of the iOS app, work directly with the founders and help shape a product used by students every day. This opportunity suits someone who enjoys autonomy, meaningful technical challenges and the pace of a small startup.

The role is fully remote within Europe. Being based in Portugal, particularly Lisbon, is a plus.

PROJECT & CONTEXT

Own the iOS app across architecture, performance, releases and technical roadmap. Collaborate closely with engineering and product leadership to improve onboarding, engagement and retention.

Build polished native experiences with smooth animations, responsive interactions and platform-specific conventions. Support and mentor the two engineers already contributing to mobile, sharing knowledge and improving engineering practices.

Work in a product-led growth environment, shipping features, instrumenting user journeys, measuring results and iterating through A/B testing. Take responsibility for App Store deployment, release cadence, versioning, store optimization and crash monitoring.

The wider platform includes Node.js, React, React Native, Next.js, NestJS, Expo, Prisma, Tailwind CSS and AWS. Specific technology versions and supported iOS versions are to be confirmed.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR (Required)

  • At least 5 years of experience in native iOS development.
  • Strong proficiency in Swift and practical experience with SwiftUI and UIKit.
  • Proven experience building and shipping consumer-grade iOS applications.
  • Familiarity with Combine, push notifications and App Store deployment.
